mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that lowers equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand that drives S&P 500 forward returns positively over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of HOUST and RSAFS growth is not predictive (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window, or interaction term is statistically insignificant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals labor market weakness that suppresses consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) signals expanding manufacturing output that boosts corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1300 thousand units, it indicates a housing market boom that stimulates consumer spending and corporate investment, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1300, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate falls below 4.0%, it signals a tight labor market that increases consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate and CPI inflation signal monetary tightening that raises equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL is not predictive (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window, or interaction term is statistically insignificant (p>0.05).
